In detail

Norfolk Constabulary recorded 335 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 7.7 per 1,000 residents, the 9th highest rate of Norwich's 13 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (11), bicycle theft (6), burglary (3); the evening/night score by violent crime (46), anti social behaviour (14), public order (7). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is University safe?

Wandroz currently rates University in Norwich as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Norwich during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Norwich at night. This rating is derived from Norfolk Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is University safe at night?

At night, University is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Norwich. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is University a good area to stay in as a tourist?

University's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Norwich) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for University?

Yes. University's rating is derived from Norfolk Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk, not an assessment — see the note on this page for the exact figure and the methodology page for full sourcing.
